detailRoute: HTTPS www.openingnights.fsu.edu /show-details/[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)* only; no query or fragment
activation: Separate exact-source operator step after deployed worker and migration verification; configuration is not activation evidence
coverage: Current official Opening Nights listing and every linked show detail; one stable current ticket notice per show reconciles explicit releases, observed links, absence and corrected announcements
availabilityPolicy: A Buy/Get Tickets link is link_observed, not verified available seats, sale-open timing or eligibility. A missing/disabled link does not imply sold out.
releasePolicy: Only explicit visible Tickets go on sale month day year at local clock copy creates ticket_release. No timezone is assumed. JSON-LD offer validFrom/availabilityStarts is ignored because observed metadata reuses performance time.
